settings.title1: A Taste of Tradition: Organic Bilona Cow Ghee
settings.content1:
Organic Bilona Cow Ghee is prepared using the hand churing traditional Bilona method, where curd is churned to extract butter, which is then simmered to produce nutrient-rich ghee preserving all nutrients. This process retains its natural aroma, golden color, and nutritional goodness.

Rich in healthy fats and essential vitamins, it supports digestion, boosts immunity, and provides natural energy. Its rich flavor enhances any dish, making it perfect for cooking, frying, or drizzling over warm foods. Barsana Magic ensures purity and tradition in every jar, offering you a wholesome, authentic experience.

settings.title: Description
settings.content:
Barsana Magic Organic Bilona Cow Ghee is prepared using the traditional Bilona method, where curd is churned to produce ghee. This method helps retain the natural nutrients and benefits of ghee, making it a wholesome and pure product.
The milk used to make our ghee comes from Indian breed cows that are raised on natural, chemical-free feed. Our Organic Bilona Cow Ghee is free from any pesticides, chemicals, or synthetic hormones, ensuring that you get a pure and natural product.
This ghee is known for its digestive properties and is commonly used to support gut health. It also contains healthy fats and essential nutrients that contribute to overall health. Barsana Magic Organic Bilona Cow Ghee is versatile, making it suitable for cooking, as well as for use in daily wellness routines.

settings.title: Key Features
settings.content:
1. Made from Indian Breed Cow Milk: Prepared using milk from cows raised on organic, chemical-free fodder in Braj Bhumi.
2. Certified to International Standards: Adheres to strict quality controls, ensuring purity and authenticity.
3. Rich in Essential Nutrients: Contains fatty acids, vitamins, and antioxidants to support overall health.
4. Promotes Digestive Health: Known for aiding digestion and improving gut health naturally.
5. Versatile Uses: Ideal for cooking, skincare, and as part of a balanced wellness routine.
6. No Synthetic Additives: Free from antibiotics, synthetic hormones, and chemical pesticides.
7. Supports Immunity: Packed with nutrients that contribute to a stronger immune system.
8. Natural Flavor & Aroma: Retains the authentic golden hue and rich aroma of traditional ghee.

settings.title: What is Barsana Magic Organic Bilona Cow Ghee?
settings.ans: Barsana Magic Organic Bilona Cow Ghee is a premium-quality organic ghee made using the traditional Bilona method. This involves hand churning curd made from milk of Indian breed cows to extract ghee, which is then slow-cooked over a wood fire to produce rich, aromatic ghee. Crafted from cows raised on organic farms, it is known for its purity, nutrients, and authentic taste.

settings.title: What are the benefits of consuming Organic Bilona Cow Ghee?
settings.ans: Barsana Magic Organic Bilona Cow Ghee provides essential vitamins like A, D, E, and K and is a good source of healthy fats. It is known for its digestive properties and adds a rich, flavorful touch to your meals.

settings.title: How is Barsana Magic Organic Bilona Cow Ghee different from regular ghee?
settings.ans: This ghee is made using the traditional Bilona method, where butter is hand-churned from curd made from milk and then slow-cooked over a wood fire. It is crafted exclusively from the milk of Indian breed cows fed natural fodder, ensuring it is free from synthetic additives and rich in nutrients.

settings.title: How can Barsana Magic Organic Bilona Cow Ghee be used in cooking?
settings.ans:
• Barsana Magic Organic Bilona Cow Ghee can be used in:
    Barsana Magic Organic Bilona Cow Ghee can be used in:
  • As a topping for breads, chapatis, or parathas
  • Baking for enhanced flavor and richness
  • Adding to rice, dals, and soups for a nutritious boost
  • Frying, sautéing, or making curries

settings.title: What makes Barsana Magic Organic Bilona Cow Ghee organic?
settings.ans: Barsana Magic Organic Bilona Cow Ghee is certified organic, made from the milk of cows raised on organic feed without antibiotics or synthetic hormones. The traditional curd-to-ghee method ensures a natural process without artificial additives, preserving its authenticity and purity.

settings.title: How should Barsana Magic Organic Bilona Cow Ghee be stored?
settings.ans: Store the ghee in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Use an airtight container to maintain its freshness and prevent it from absorbing external odors.

settings.title: What is the shelf life of Barsana Magic Organic Bilona Cow Ghee?
settings.ans: When stored properly, Barsana Magic Organic Bilona Cow Ghee has a shelf life of up to 12 months without requiring refrigeration.

settings.title: Is Barsana Magic Organic Bilona Cow Ghee suitable for all age groups?
settings.ans: Yes, Barsana Magic Organic Bilona Ghee can be suitable for people of all ages, including children, pregnant women, and the elderly. It is a nutritious addition to a balanced diet and can be enjoyed in moderation by the entire family.
